findings.text: PLAN_REVIEW_NODE recomposes the plan-review node id as f"{PLAN_REVIEW_NODE_PREFIX}{PLAN_SLUG}{PLAN_REVIEW_RUBRIC_SUFFIX}" instead of calling the owner of that composition, _plan_review_node_id at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1251-1262; the added definition duplicates the owner's design-rubric branch rather than wrapping it, so a change to the owner's composition reddens this file again on the same precondition that produced the original red, while calling the owner keeps the seeded prior row matched to the composer by construction.

The base-arm row gives only counts and EXIT=1, but the done_when asks for the base run with its failing ids logged beside the head run in this fragment; the three ids exist only in base-run-named-file.log at the run directory, so a reader of the delivered evidence cannot see which cases the repair turned green.

The reviewed manifest's artifacts line records the neighbour arm as prose naming neighbour-arm-base.log and neighbour-arm-head.log (44 passed each) rather than as the inline JSON with full 40-character revisions the done_when requires, and it records no ruff check or format result although the done_when asks ruff to report nothing new on the changed paths; both checks hold (ruff reports All checks passed and 1 file already formatted on the reviewed file), but neither is recorded where the done_when asks for it.
